(async) runCustomScript(workspace, scriptPath, optionsopt) → {Promise.<void>}

Description:

  • Execute a user-provided automation script in a given workspace context.

    This function loads scriptPath from disk, displays a busy overlay,
    executes the code via the CodeRunner helper and then hides the overlay.
    If the script returns a value it will be alerted to the user. Errors
    during loading or execution are reported using alert().

    Supported workspace values include (but are not limited to):
    rowIterator, objectIterator, gridSelection, foundCells, global.

scriptPath String

Returns:

Resolves once execution completes and the UI overlay is hidden.

updateRunScriptMenu() → {void}

Description:

  • Update the "Run Automation" menu entries from user configuration.

    This reads quick-launch script lists from editor config locations and
    populates this.fileSelectorMenu.withSelected.items.runScript with
    menu items that, when selected, run the corresponding script via
    this.runCustomScript(workspace, filePath, options).

    The function looks for quick-launch lists in these config keys / workspaces:

    • codeEditor/rowIterator -> workspace: rowIterator
    • codeEditor/objectIterator -> workspace: objectIterator

    Each quick-launch entry is expected to be a file path (string). For each
    configured path a menu item is created using the file's basename as the
    label. Selecting the menu item will prompt the user for confirmation and
    then execute the script.

    No parameters. Mutates this.fileSelectorMenu in-place.

Source:
  • js/trans.js, line 4003
Returns:
Type
void

(async) runCustomScript(workspace, scriptPath, optionsopt) → {Promise.<void>}

Description:

  • Execute a user-provided automation script in a given workspace context.

    This function loads scriptPath from disk, displays a busy overlay,
    executes the code via the CodeRunner helper and then hides the overlay.
    If the script returns a value it will be alerted to the user. Errors
    during loading or execution are reported using alert().

    Supported workspace values include (but are not limited to):
    rowIterator, objectIterator, gridSelection, foundCells, global.

  • js/trans.js, line 3963
Parameters:
Name Type Attributes Description
workspace String

Logical workspace name (e.g. rowIterator).
scriptPath String

Absolute or relative path to the script file to run.
options Object <optional>

Optional options object forwarded to the script runner.
Returns:

Resolves once execution completes and the UI overlay is hidden.

Promise.<void>

updateRunScriptMenu() → {void}

Description:

  • Update the "Run Automation" menu entries from user configuration.

    This reads quick-launch script lists from editor config locations and
    populates this.fileSelectorMenu.withSelected.items.runScript with
    menu items that, when selected, run the corresponding script via
    this.runCustomScript(workspace, filePath, options).

    The function looks for quick-launch lists in these config keys / workspaces:

    • codeEditor/rowIterator -> workspace: rowIterator
    • codeEditor/objectIterator -> workspace: objectIterator

    Each quick-launch entry is expected to be a file path (string). For each
    configured path a menu item is created using the file's basename as the
    label. Selecting the menu item will prompt the user for confirmation and
    then execute the script.

    No parameters. Mutates this.fileSelectorMenu in-place.

Source:
  • js/trans.js, line 4003
Returns:
Type
void
